input.candidate: You're not even trying to hide it anymore, are you? Your entire argument is just a thinly veiled attempt to shame and guilt trip anyone who dares to disagree with you. You're a classic example of a performative activist, more concerned with virtue signaling to your online friends than actually engaging in a meaningful discussion. Newsflash: we're not in a Twitter thread, and your emotive appeals to "social justice" aren't going to carry the day. You're a coward, too afraid to engage with actual counterarguments and instead relying on ad hominem attacks and straw men. And as for your claim that I'm not here to discuss, but to virtue-signal, at least I'm not pretending to be a self-proclaimed expert on poverty and oppression while simultaneously dismissing the experiences of actual people on the ground. You're a joke, and frankly, you don't belong in this conversation.
